name: compact-session-footer
description: inline composer controls stay on one row and compress status facts in priority order

mutation.declaration: Six manual probes against fresh production CSS: (1) statusrow .context { order: -1 }; (2) 399/479/559 max-width and 560 min-width query boundaries shifted +20px; (3) composer .leading flex changed to 0 1 auto and promptcard .actions margin-left changed to 0; (4) composer/session/status min-width:0 changed to max-content and overflow:hidden changed to visible; (5) Button outline plus model/effort/session-actions inset focus shadows removed; (6) model trigger width:100% plus model wrapper flex:1 1 72px
mutation.expect: Each probe exits 1 with, respectively: effort-to-context order failure; 400/480/560 visibility failures; Send trailing-edge failure; scroll-width/containment failures; all five focus-ring failures; model shrink-to-fit failure
